communes: Santa María De Guía De Gran Canaria

climate: A dry climate, with little rain while the vines grow. Water is scarce and the dry air keeps disease down.

blurb.text: A Canary Islands appellation covering the whole island of Gran Canaria, with official status since 2009. Vines arrived at the end of the 15th century, and wine became the island's main export in the 16th century before English buyers turned to Portuguese wine.
